title: SUI in Space
tagline: Space exploration game with zkLogin authentication and AI-powered fleet   battles on Sui blockchain
description:
Sui-In-Space is a blockchain-based space exploration game built on Sui that combines seamless zkLogin authentication with strategic gameplay. Players
  command space missions, manage AI-controlled fleets, and participate in on-chain governance to shape the game's future. The game features real-time mission
  mechanics where players select AI agents to execute various space operations, earning rewards and advancing through the galaxy. With zkLogin integration,
  players can authenticate using familiar OAuth providers (Google) without needing to manage private keys directly, lowering the barrier to entry for Web3
  gaming while maintaining full custody of their assets.
how_its_made:
Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite for the frontend, Sui-In-Space leverages the Sui blockchain's Move smart contracts for game logic and asset
  management. We integrated zkLogin using @mysten/sui SDK and Shinami's prover service for gasless authentication flows. The UI uses @mysten/dapp-kit for
  wallet connectivity alongside our custom auth context that unifies traditional wallet and zkLogin experiences. State management combines React Query for
  blockchain data fetching with custom hooks for real-time updates. The game features a holographic cyan/purple design system built with Tailwind CSS.
  Transaction flows use Sui's Transaction builder for complex multi-call operations like mission execution and governance voting. We implemented a mock
  actions provider for development that allowed rapid iteration without constant blockchain calls.
